title: Words highlighted as they are spoken
blurb: The browser reads a paragraph aloud with SpeechSynthesis. Each boundary event gives the position of a word, the page turns it into a Range rectangle, and the canvas draws a spotlight, a magnified copy or a sweep on that word. Tap a word to start from it. A voice that sends no boundary events is stepped by a timer.
question: Do SpeechSynthesis boundary events arrive well enough to draw an effect on each word as it is spoken, and can the paragraph still be tapped while a magnified copy of a word is drawn?
result: The drawing and the tap handling work from boundary events. Whether a voice sends them depends on the device: the page counts them and falls back to a timer.
